page.overview:
Who is Lima?

Lima is a baby Velociraptor. Lima can be seen within the Raptor Encounter attraction at Universal Orlando. Lima was first shown off around January 15, 2025.

Lima appears similar in color pattern and design to Delta and Sierra.
